_comment: Copy this file to configs/checkpoints.json and edit the paths. Relative paths are relative to the repository root. If expected_sha256 is set, a file with a different hash is REFUSED (never silently substituted). Set expected_sha256 to null to accept a different file; its actual hash is still recorded in every result row.

pretrained.description: Original TinyViT-5M-224, 22k->1k distilled (microsoft/Cream release tiny_vit_5m_22kto1k_distill.pth). Downloaded automatically with --download-pretrained if missing.

qat_int4.description: QAT-INT4 TinyViT-5M (FP32 latent weights, no quantizer state stored).

qat_int8.description: QAT-INT8 TinyViT-5M (FP32 latent weights, no quantizer state stored).
